description: Single-seat Draken inside Hangar 2. Visitors may sit in the cockpit and the afterburner section was being refitted in 2026.
Two-seat Canadair-built CF-104D. Previously on loan to Hjallerup Mekaniske Museum and later restored at Aalborg.
Two-seat Danish Super Sabre. Previously stored at the former Flyvestation Tirstrup.
Thunderjet displayed in Hangar 2 wearing squadron code SE-G. Airframe identity not confirmed.
Royal Danish Navy Super Lynx. Rotor blades refitted in 2026.
Returned to Hangar 2 in March 2026 after a Jutland tour.
